io_driver_functions.notes: Byte-copy RAM->SRAM (src,dst,len=0x38C); sets WAITCNT-style register (*_DAT & mask | 3) before loop. Low-level SRAM write driver
SRAM->RAM copy (src SRAM,dst RAM,len=0x38C) via stack-relocated trampoline FUN_08098a38; sets same wait register
Verify/compare after write (stack-relocated trampoline); writer treats return 0 as success for that copy
Stamps byte0=0x0D, byte1=slot, computes ~sum16 at +0x388, writes+verifies all 4 copies at slot*0xE30+0x0E000000
Loads copies in order until magic+byte1<3+checksum pass; calls FUN_0800c4a8 default-init if all 4 fail; returns found flag via jumptable continuation

Default-init: DMA-zeroes 0x38C block (FUN_080008a0) and 0x118 sub-struct, preserves byte2 clamped <=4, writes default stats, then FUN_0800c428(0x14)/FUN_0800c34c(0)/FUN_0800c39c(1,1) helper chain (all -> FUN_0800bbb8)

Save-all: clamps param 0..4; for slot 0..2: FUN_0800c654(slot), *(RAM+2)=param, FUN_0800c5cc(slot)
Default helper: writes byte at struct+DAT and *(base+0x26C)&0xCF|8, calls FUN_0800bbb8, conditionally zeroes +0xCC/+0xCD
Default helper: FUN_0800b564 dispatch, *(base+0x68)&0xCF|8, FUN_0800bbb8, conditional zero via DAT_0800c3fc
Default helper: maps param (0x15->2,0x16->3,else 1) to FUN_0800b330, writes char at base+DAT_0800c46c (param-0x14 or -1), FUN_0800bbb8
